## Market.getAvgSupplyRate() method

Returns the average rate at which interest \_would\_ accrue for suppliers of this market, if `accrueInterest` was called at the given timestamp (scaled by WAD).

**Signature:**

```typescript
getAvgSupplyRate(timestamp?: BigIntish): bigint;
```
